header: One person as the way in
lead: Portrait, name, role, a sentence in their own voice, and two ways to reach them. The quotation is a blockquote inside a figure, so the attribution belongs to the words rather than following them as loose text.
author: The name goes in author
role: And the job title in role
quote_text: The sentence in their own voice belongs in quote_text, and it should sound like something the person would actually say out loud.
note: Use a real photograph of a real colleague and keep it current: a stock portrait beside a direct line loses exactly the trust the panel exists for.
